title: Validator vote to delist TON
content: {"blocks":[{"key":"cu7cj","text":"Validators will vote on whether to delist TON on June 15 around 9:00 UTC. TON is being rebranded to GRAM. This permissionless stake-based vote weighting primitive is built natively into HyperCore and technically requires no offchain coordination. If validators vote to delist an asset, the perps will settle to the 1 hour time weighted spot oracle price before the scheduled delisting voting time, and open orders will be canceled. Close any positions beforehand to avoid automatic settlement. After settlement, no new orders will be accepted.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"offset":0,"length":543,"style":"color-rgb(255,255,255)"},{"offset":0,"length":543,"style":"bgcolor-rgb(15,26,31)"},{"offset":0,"length":543,"style":"fontsize-14"},{"offset":0,"length":543,"style":"fontfamily-OurFont, system-ui, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, Ubuntu, \"Helvetica Neue\", sans-serif"},{"offset":0,"length":543,"style":"color-rgb(0,0,0)"},{"offset":0,"length":543,"style":"bgcolor-rgb(255,255,255)"},{"offset":0,"length":543,"style":"fontsize-12"},{"offset":0,"length":543,"style":"fontfamily-Inter, sans-serif"}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{"text-align":"start"}}],"entityMap":{}}
